text: いどむと　いうなら　かくご　していけ

structure.jp: いどむと　いうなら
structure.en: if you say you'll challenge him

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.explanation: と plus いう wraps up what someone says: 'say that'. いどむと　いう = 'you say you'll challenge him'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a plain verb means 'if that is the case'. いどむと　いうなら = 'if you say you'll challenge him'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb means do it and then go. いけ is the blunt order form. かくご　していけ = 'steel yourself and go'.
